text: dsh-composer-stretch 是面向 DSH 网页端的输入框扩展插件：当草稿达到三行时，它会在输入框右上角显示全屏按钮，也可以连续按三次 Shift+Enter 自动展开。展开后输入区接近全屏高度，并保留附件轨道空间；普通 Enter 用于换行，Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 仍可发送，发送后会自动收起。插件还限制输入框滚动向会话背景传递，并提供中英文按钮文案。适合经常编写较长提示词、希望在 DSH 中获得更大编辑区域的用户；无需额外配置。

dsh-composer-stretch expands the DSH web composer for long drafts. The button appears after three lines; three Shift+Enter presses also expand it. Expanded mode leaves room for attachments, uses Enter for line breaks, keeps Cmd/Ctrl+Enter for sending, and collapses after sending.
想在 DSH 里把输入框临时放大，方便写长提示词。
草稿换成好几行时，能不能给我一个更大的编辑区域？
希望连续按几次 Shift+Enter 就能展开输入框。
展开编辑时我想让普通 Enter 换行，而不是立刻发送。
输入框变高以后，粘贴附件也别把编辑区域挤出屏幕。
能让输入框滚动到边缘时不要带着对话背景一起滚吗？
I want more room to edit a long prompt in the DSH composer.
Can the composer expand when my draft wraps across several lines?
dsh-composer-stretch 的功能「输入框全屏展开」：草稿达到三行时显示展开按钮，点击后输入区扩展到接近全屏高度，再次点击恢复。也可连续按三次 Shift+Enter 触发展开。
dsh-composer-stretch 的功能「展开模式换行」：展开时，普通 Enter 在输入框插入换行；Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 仍交给 DSH 发送，输入法组合输入不被拦截。
dsh-composer-stretch 的功能「附件与发送适配」：展开高度会为附件轨道留出空间，发送后自动收起；输入框滚动到边缘时也会限制滚动传递到会话背景。

text:
dsh-composer-stretch README · 触发方式：- **条件显示** — 输入框行数 ≥ 3 行时，右上角出现扩展按钮，点击可扩展输入框高度
- **三连换行自动扩展** — 连续按 3 次 `Shift+Enter` 自动进入扩展模式

dsh-composer-stretch README · 扩展后效果：- **全屏输入** — 扩展后，输入框达到接近全屏高度（已做适配，不会被会话标题、输入框图片等组件遮挡）。
- **附件让位** — 展开时粘贴图片或文件，输入区自动让出附件轨道的高度（卡片总高度不变），不会被顶出会话可视区
- **发送后自动折叠** — 发送消息后自动恢复默认高度，无需手动关闭
- **扩展后 Enter 换行** — 展开模式下 `Enter` 与 `Shift+Enter` 换行，`Cmd/Ctrl+Enter` 发送；收起时 `Enter` 仍是发送
- **滚动不穿透** — 扩展后修复 DSH 输入框内滚动到边缘时会滚动背景对话区的问题

dsh-composer-stretch README · 其他说明：- **已适配至 DSH v0.2.0-rc.2**
- **稳定 UI** - 依赖高稳定性的 `data-slot` 标识 + DSH 官方设计令牌，兼容性好，与原生系统适配度极高
- **不持久化** — 刷新页面恢复默认状态，无 localStorage 残留
- **纯前端** — 无自定义协议、无 host 命令、无 LLM 调用、不进会话日志

A composer expand plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). When the composer text wraps to 3+ lines, an expand button appears in the top-right corner of the composer; click to stretch the composer to fullscreen height, click again to restore the default height.

dsh-composer-stretch README · dsh-composer-stretch：https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3d15f435-284f-4cbe-87c1-e59e47c64667

The interaction is inspired by Gemini, with additional DSH-specific height adaption and scroll-through prevention fixes.
dsh-composer-stretch README · Install：```sh
dsh-composer-stretch README · Web profile：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-composer-stretch

dsh-composer-stretch README · Desktop app: quit the app first：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-composer-stretch
```
section: Desktop app: quit the app first

text:
dsh-composer-stretch README · Triggers：- **Conditional button** — the expand button appears in the top-right when the composer reaches 3+ lines.
- **Triple-newline auto-expand** — press `Shift+Enter` three times in a row to auto-expand.

dsh-composer-stretch README · Expand behavior：- **Fullscreen composer** — the composer stretches to near-fullscreen height (adapted to avoid occlusion by the session title, image attachments, etc.).
- **Attachment room** — pasting an image or file while expanded gives the attachment rail back exactly its own height from the draft area, so the card keeps its size instead of overflowing the conversation area.
- **Auto-collapse on send** — the composer restores its default height after sending a message.
- **Enter behavior while expanded** — `Enter` and `Shift+Enter` insert newlines; `Cmd/Ctrl+Enter` sends. Collapsed, `Enter` still sends.
- **Scroll containment** — scrolling inside the expanded composer no longer chains through to the conversation background.

dsh-composer-stretch README · Notes：- **Tested against DSH v0.2.0-rc.2**
- **Stable UI** — relies on stable `data-slot` anchors and DSH design tokens for high compatibility.
- **No persistence** — state resets on page refresh; no localStorage residue.
- **Frontend only** — no custom protocols, no host commands, no LLM calls, no session-log entries.
